entries.name: DepositContract
entries.description: Ethereum Beacon Chain deposit contract.

entries.name: AuctionManager
entries.description: Node-operator bid auction: operators post bids that are consumed when validators are assigned to them.

entries.name: EtherFiAdmin
entries.description: Executor that validates and applies EtherFiOracle reports (rebase, withdrawal finalization, validator approvals) subject to per-task bounds.

entries.name: EtherFiRestaker
entries.description: Routes protocol ETH/LSTs into EigenLayer restaking and Lido withdrawals. EigenLayer and Lido contracts are external dependencies.

entries.name: AvsOperatorManager
entries.description: Deploys and controls per-AVS operator contracts (behind a beacon) for EigenLayer AVS registration. EigenLayer core is external.

entries.name: StakingManager
entries.description: Registers validators and creates EtherFiNode instances (behind a beacon). Batches beacon-chain deposits from LiquidityPool ETH.

entries.name: UpgradeableBeacon
entries.description: A beacon with an upgradeable implementation currently set as eth:0xf4718766a7fc8c81F788669B0985FAC03D064D29. Beacon proxy contracts pointing to this beacon will all use its implementation.

entries.name: EtherFiViewer
entries.description: Stateless read-only aggregator for off-chain interfaces. Holds no funds or permissions.

entries.name: LiquidityPool
entries.description: The protocol hub and ETH custodian. Holds pooled ETH, mints/burns eETH, prices shares, routes deposits to validators via StakingManager and serves withdrawals through the WithdrawRequestNFT queue and the EtherFiRedemptionManager buffer.

entries.name: PriorityWithdrawalQueue
entries.description: Priority lane of the withdrawal system for privileged/large redemptions.

entries.name: eETH
entries.description: Rebasing liquid staking token. Balances are shares × the LiquidityPool exchange rate and total supply tracks pooled ETH. Only the LiquidityPool can mint and burn.

entries.name: UpgradeableBeacon
entries.description: A beacon with an upgradeable implementation currently set as eth:0x556Db8c611FE63e694413F718d795f976dcF5881. Beacon proxy contracts pointing to this beacon will all use its implementation.

entries.name: MembershipManager
entries.description: Manages membership NFTs recording loyalty points and tiers for depositors.

entries.name: RevokeAdmin
entries.description: Contract that can revoke admin and other roles in an emergency.

entries.name: EtherFiNode
entries.description: Per-node implementation (behind a beacon) that holds an EigenLayer EigenPod and splits validator rewards. EigenLayer contracts are external.

entries.name: Blacklister
entries.description: Holds the blacklist consulted by eETH/weETH transfers.

entries.name: EtherFiOracle
entries.description: Committee oracle: members submit periodic reports (beacon balances, rewards, withdrawal amounts) that reach consensus before EtherFiAdmin applies them.

entries.name: RoleRegistry
entries.description: Central access-control registry: named roles gate privileged functions across the protocol. Role membership is read live.

entries.name: EtherFiRateLimiter
entries.description: Shared rate limiter that bounds sensitive flows (e.g. withdrawals) per epoch.

entries.name: CumulativeMerkleDrop
entries.description: Distributor for cumulative Merkle-based claims of KING reward tokens.

entries.name: EtherFiRewardsRouter
entries.description: Routes execution-layer/consensus rewards ETH back to the LiquidityPool and treasury.

entries.name: WithdrawRequestNFT
entries.description: The eETH withdrawal queue. Burning eETH mints an NFT claim that the oracle and admin finalize, after which holders redeem it for ETH.

entries.name: AddressProvider
entries.description: Legacy address registry mapping protocol contract names to addresses.

entries.name: RestakingRewardsRouter
entries.description: Routes EigenLayer restaking rewards to their recipients. The reward token is external.

entries.name: EtherFiNodesManager
entries.description: Manages the fleet of EtherFiNode contracts: withdrawal credentials, rewards distribution and validator lifecycle.

entries.name: CumulativeMerkleRewardsDistributor
entries.description: Cumulative Merkle distributor for protocol rewards.

entries.name: EtherFiTimelock
entries.description: OpenZeppelin TimelockController governing contract upgrades and privileged operations. Two instances: a longer Upgrade timelock and a shorter Operating timelock.

entries.name: Liquifier
entries.description: Accepts whitelisted liquid staking tokens and restaked positions in exchange for eETH, later unwinding them to ETH.

entries.name: MembershipNFT
entries.description: ERC-1155 membership NFT recording loyalty and tier points.

entries.name: EtherfiOFTAdapterUpgradeable
entries.description: LayerZero OFT lock-box for weETH: locks mainnet weETH against cross-chain mint/burn. The LayerZero endpoint is external.

entries.name: EtherFiTimelock
entries.description: OpenZeppelin TimelockController governing contract upgrades and privileged operations. Two instances: a longer Upgrade timelock and a shorter Operating timelock.

entries.name: weETH
entries.description: Non-rebasing wrapper of eETH. wrap() and unwrap() convert at the LiquidityPool rate. getRate() returns the eETH-per-weETH price.

entries.name: DepositAdapter
entries.description: User-facing helper that wraps ETH and accepted liquid staking tokens into weETH in one call.

entries.name: EtherFiOperationParameters
entries.description: Holds tunable operational parameters and per-role operator addresses.

entries.name: NodeOperatorManager
entries.description: Registry of permissioned node operators and their key/bid allowances.

entries.name: EtherfiL1SyncPoolETH
entries.description: L1 side of the cross-chain deposit sync pool: mints eETH against ETH bridged from L2s via LayerZero. The endpoint is external.

entries.name: EtherFiRedemptionManager
entries.description: Instant-redemption buffer: swaps eETH/weETH for ETH from a liquidity buffer at a fee, bypassing the withdrawal queue up to available liquidity.

entries.name: WeETHWithdrawAdapter
entries.description: Helper that lets a holder go from weETH directly into the eETH withdrawal queue in one transaction.
